task.question: What is the name of the super-Earth with a confirmed atmosphere reported on July 16, 2026?
task.evidence: 16 July – Astronomers report the first observationally confirmed atmosphere around a rocky exoplanet within its star's habitable zone, after detecting helium escaping from the upper atmosphere of LHS 1140 b, a super-Earth approximately 49 light-years from Earth.

Content: 55 Cancri e (abbreviated 55 Cnc e), also named Janssen, is an exoplanet in the orbit of the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A. The mass and radius of the planet indicate it is likely a super-Earth. The planet was discovered in 2004.The planet orbits at 0.01544 AU from its star with an orbital period of 0.7365 days (17.68 hours), thus being much closer to its star than Mercury is to the Sun. Due to the extreme proximity to its parent star, the planet is tidally locked and receives enormous amounts of radiation. At the same time, the heat side of the planet could have temperatures around 2,000 K (1,730 °C; 3,140 °F), while dark side temperatures are perhaps 1,000 K (730 °C; 1,340 °F) cooler. Astronomers have discovered that the exoplanet 55 Cancri e has a substantial atmosphere, possibly consisting primarily of carbon dioxide or carbon monoxide. The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) provided first evidence of an atmosphere around 55 Cancri e in May 2024.
